title: VXAce Does anyone know how to make a character fall into a hole in a cutscene?

posts.author: DeadManDan98
posts.body: I want to make a character fall into a hole in a cut scene, but I don't know how to make a hole an event. Some help!

posts.author: Timtrack
posts.body:
Define what you mean by falling in a hole?
If if is about a cutscene while your team is falling (from the sky or whatever) you can force move the player to go down in a vertically looping map.

posts.author: pawsplay
posts.body: Well, for the event itself, you'll probably want to make the outside of the hole into the sprite. That way, it can appear above the character and they can go "under" it when they fall.

posts.author: Arcaines
posts.body:
Yeah depending on how you want to do this visual as well.
you could go, character walks onto the hole and just instant disappears, or the sprite gets smaller, or the character gradual fades, or turns black etc.

Ok so the issue with this is, that it's 3D, 2.5D but not 2D.
So the angles can't be done the way the video shows in RPG maker and Mario is using different sprites in that scene as well.
The best way to replicate that is:
make a event with the through settings ticked on.
Make event the same as the character, make the player invisible, then use "Set movement" event, then make the event move down.
This will make look like the player is falling down but since the event is moving and not the player then the camera will stay still on the player.
you may need to change the events image to a character falling sprite though.
